Block is one company built from many blocks, all united by the same purpose of economic empowerment. The blocks that form our foundational teams — People, Finance, Counsel, Hardware, Information Security, Platform Infrastructure Engineering, and more — provide support and guidance at the corporate level. They work across business groups and around the globe, spanning time zones and disciplines to develop inclusive People policies, forecast finances, give legal counsel, safeguard systems, nurture new initiatives, and more. Every challenge creates possibilities, and we need different perspectives to see them all. Bring yours to Block.

The Role

The Data Enablement team builds the platforms and frameworks that move and serve data across Block. We support four core capabilities—online and offline data projections, third-party data integration, and graph data stores—for customers across the company, including Risk, Compliance, Data Engineering, and Data Science.

As a Senior Software Engineer on the team, you will design, build, and operate backend systems that make data easier to acquire, process, and use. Your work will include expanding Block’s external data acquisition capabilities and contributing to Sessions, which brings customer activity data together for analytics and machine learning, among other high-priority initiatives. You will help shape technical direction, own projects from design through production, and build shared capabilities that other teams can use.

We’re looking for a strong systems engineer who brings sound architectural judgment, takes ownership of outcomes, and is eager to learn across the backend and data engineering worlds. A deep data engineering background is valuable, but it is not a prerequisite.

You Will

  • Design and build shared backend services, platforms, and frameworks that support data acquisition, processing, and access across Block.
  • Lead projects from problem definition and architecture through implementation, rollout, and ongoing production operation.
  • Work across backend services, event-driven systems, and batch and streaming data processing to deliver reliable capabilities for downstream consumers.
  • Partner with software engineers on the team and across the organization, Data Foundations engineers, and data scientists to turn their needs into reusable platform capabilities.
  • Make practical architectural decisions that balance reliability, latency, scalability, cost, and maintainability.
  • Improve the observability, data quality, and operational reliability of the systems you build and support.
  • Mentor engineers, contribute to technical standards, and grow familiar with the team’s other domains over time.

You Have

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent experience.
  • Deep experience designing, building, and operating distributed backend systems in production.
  • A track record of leading technical projects, making sound architectural decisions, and turning ambiguous problems into well-defined, deliverable work.
  • Proficiency in a backend programming language such as Java or Kotlin, with strong software design and engineering fundamentals.
  • Experience building on cloud infrastructure, ideally AWS.
  • The ability to learn unfamiliar systems and domains, communicate technical trade-offs clearly, and collaborate across software engineering, data engineering, and data science.
  • Bonus points for a data engineering background, including data pipelines, large-scale processing, or lakehouse and warehouse systems.
  • Bonus points for hands-on experience with Kafka and Spark Structured Streaming. Experience building and operating low-latency streaming systems with Spark Structured Streaming is especially valuable.

Technologies We Use and Teach

  • Kafka, Spark, Spark Structured Streaming, Iceberg, Databricks, Snowflake, dbt, Prefect, block-forge, DataHub, Java, Kotlin, AWS, CloudEvents.
  • You do not need prior experience with every technology in our stack.

Strategic Account Director, Latin America

Remote first with a São Paulo office available · Full-time · Sales · Reports to the Head of LatAm

About DFNS

Finance is moving onchain. Stablecoins, tokenized deposits, securities and funds are changing how money and assets are issued, held and transferred. The destination is a financial system where any asset can be issued, moved and governed onchain with the controls regulated institutions require. That shift needs a new foundation. Just as core banking systems manage accounts and ledgers today, financial institutions need a platform to manage digital assets. DFNS is that platform. Today, we secure hundreds of billions of dollars in assets every month for more than 500 clients worldwide.

Why this role

Latin America has moved faster than most regions on stablecoins and digital assets, with fintechs, payment companies and banks putting them to work for cross border payments, treasury and savings. We have clients in production across the region and a growing presence in São Paulo. You will be the senior commercial counterpart for those clients. In year one you will own net revenue retention for the regional portfolio, lead every renewal and expansion and build the account playbook the next hire runs.

What you’ll do

  • Own a portfolio of institutional accounts across Latin America as their senior commercial counterpart, from onboarding to renewal.

  • Grow net revenue retention by finding and closing expansion into new products, volumes, entities and markets.

  • Lead renewals and commercial negotiations so contracts stay aligned with how clients actually use the platform.

  • Drive onboarding and adoption with Delivery and Solutions so clients reach production and scale on schedule.

  • Run executive business reviews that tie DFNS usage to each client’s business goals.

  • Carry the voice of Latin American clients into Product, Compliance and leadership.

  • Turn satisfied clients into references and case studies, and represent DFNS at regional events.

What you bring

Must-haves

  • Experience managing and growing enterprise accounts in financial services or fintech in Latin America, with a record of renewals and expansion.

  • Professional fluency in Portuguese, Spanish and English.

  • Technical fluency to discuss APIs, integrations, deployment models and controls with a client’s engineers and compliance teams.

  • Commercial negotiation experience across renewals, pricing and contracts.

  • Comfort working in regulated environments with banks and payment institutions and their compliance stakeholders.

  • Based in the region, able to travel across it and comfortable being the senior DFNS presence there, with mornings overlapping Europe.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience in digital assets, stablecoins, custody or payments infrastructure.

  • Time at a core banking, payments or capital markets technology vendor.

  • A network at Latin American banks, payment companies or fintechs.

How we work

We are a distributed company headquartered in Paris. Our teams work from Europe, the US and Asia, with offices in New York, Geneva, Dubai, Singapore, Hong Kong and São Paulo. We write decisions down so they survive time zones. We hold our own work to the standards our clients are held to. We hire people who can own an outcome end to end and we give them the room to do it.

What we offer

A competitive base salary set by role and location, a bonus or variable plan where the role carries one and stock options vesting over four years. Healthcare, flexible vacation, parental leave and a one-time home technology allowance, with travel expenses covered. A MacBook and the equipment you need to do your best work. Remote first, with an office if you want one.

Base salary range: $80,000-120,000

Hiring process

We aim to complete the process in 2 weeks and we tell you where you stand after every step.

  1. Intro call with Co-CEO (30 minutes).

  2. Personality and cognitive assessments, completed on your own time (45 minutes).

  3. Focus interviews with the hiring panel in role-specific sessions (about 3 hours in total).

  4. Reference calls and background checks.

Equal opportunity

DFNS is an equal opportunity employer and considers every applicant based on ability and potential, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age or any other characteristic protected by law. If you need an accommodation at any point in the process, tell us and we will arrange it.

Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Events Marketing team is part of Stripe's broader Americas Marketing organization and builds high-impact event experiences across key industry, product, and segment priorities. The Product and Financial Services portfolio supports programs that drive pipeline, deepen customer relationships, and accelerate adoption of Stripe's revenue and financial infrastructure products. In this role, you'd join a team that values precision, creativity, sound judgment, and strong operational partnership.

What you’ll do

We're looking for an experienced events professional to own the planning and execution of a focused portfolio of Product and Financial Services events within AMER Events Marketing. You'll lead end-to-end delivery of event programs aligned to Stripe's Financial Services and product go-to-market priorities, spanning third-party industry conferences and Stripe-hosted experiences. Your portfolio will include Financial Services programs such as Money20/20 and product-focused industry events. Day to day, you'll manage multiple concurrent programs while partnering closely with field marketing, product marketing, partner marketing, and external agencies to deliver experiences that support pipeline, account engagement, and relationship depth.

Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end planning, coordination, and onsite execution for a portfolio of Financial Services and product-focused third-party and first-party events, including Money20/20.
  • Translate event objectives into clear program plans, audience experiences, workbacks, staffing plans, and success measures
  • Partner with field marketing, demand generation, product marketing, partner marketing and industry go-to-market teams to align programs with business priorities and audience needs
  • Develop, manage, and track event budgets, surfacing variances, timeline risks, and scope tradeoffs early with recommended paths forward
  • Serve as the primary event point of contact for agencies, vendors, venues, and other external partners supporting the portfolio.
  • Manage logistics end to end, including venue sourcing, vendor coordination, contracts, catering, audio/visual, staffing, run-of-show, and onsite execution
  • Independently manage day-to-day planning and delivery across assigned programs, coordinating stakeholders and keeping workbacks on track.
  • Maintain accurate event data in relevant event-management and CRM systems to support registration, lead capture, pipeline attribution, and reporting.
  • Lead post-event reporting across pipeline influence, lead generation, engagement, and budget performance, and turn findings into practical improvements
  • Present post-event findings, learnings, and recommendations to the Head of AMER Events and relevant GTM stakeholders.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 4–6 years of event-management experience, preferably in B2B technology, fintech, financial services, payments, or product marketing.
  • Demonstrated experience delivering third-party sponsorships and company-hosted events from planning through onsite execution and post-event reporting.
  • Strong organizational and project-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple high-stakes events concurrently.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills across marketing, sales, product, and executive audiences.
  • Experience managing event budgets, vendors, agencies, and operational details.
  • Comfort operating in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities and cross-functional dependencies.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience producing Financial Services, fintech, payments, or product-marketing events.
  • Familiarity with product and industry events such as Money20/20, MRC, and MAG.
  • Familiarity with Revenue, Money Management, or related Stripe product narratives.
  • Proficiency with Salesforce and event-management platforms such as Splash, Cvent, or comparable tools.
  • Experience supporting executive-level programs, including roundtables, hosted dinners, and invitation-only summits.
  • Strong analytical mindset and experience using event data to inform decisions and report pipeline attribution.
descriptions.job-1nty056:
Who we are 

We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe’s safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing.

Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, “roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen” kind of people. It’s these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let’s go!

Your mission

Bitpanda serves millions of investors across Europe, and we're bringing regulated finance onchain with Vision Chain, our own OP Stack L2 blockchain. We are looking for a Lead Product Manager, DeFi to build Bitpanda’s DeFi ecosystem from the ground up, creating the world’s premier Euro-denominated DeFi ecosystem while making it safe, accessible, and intuitive for our customers. 

The first use case is crypto-backed borrowing and lending in the Bitpanda app, with an eye to then build more sophisticated products and use cases leveraging tokenized commodities, securities, funds, and structured products. You’ll decide which protocols and partners come to Vision Chain, and work collaboratively to bring DeFi to Bitpanda customers in a way that feels as simple as the app they already trust. You'll work in a small, senior team with our smart contract engineers and Bitpanda's Legal, Compliance and Risk teams, as an individual contributor reporting to the Head of Web3 Product.

What you’ll do 

  • Design and run the lending markets: set loan-to-value and liquidation thresholds, interest rate curves, caps, and oracles, while also owning monitoring and incident playbooks.
  • Bring liquidity and users to permissioned markets and assets: set supply targets, bring in euro liquidity from stablecoin issuers, institutional lenders, curated vaults and market makers, and work out how verified customers reach these markets, without paying for volume.
  • Make sure the right DeFi infrastructure is in place, particularly for permissioned tokenized assets: DEX liquidity deep enough for swaps and liquidations, liquidators, oracles and the other building blocks the markets depend on.
  • Shape what customers see, sign, and own in the Bitpanda app, including how liquidation and risk are explained, and measure real use: borrowers who come back, bad debt and revenue, not total value locked alone.
  • Recommend which protocols and partners come to Vision Chain, backed by a business case, and work with Legal, Compliance and Risk from day one on EU consumer credit rules and MiCA.

Who you are 

  • 6+ years of Product Management experience, with at least 3+ years focused specifically on building and scaling DeFi or crypto products.
  • You know lending markets in depth: collateral and liquidation mechanics, interest rate models, oracles and how they fail, curation and bad debt. You're at home with the EVM and can read Solidity smart contract code well enough to question engineers about it.
  • Demonstrated experience bringing DeFi applications into regulated consumer products and successfully bridging the gap between decentralized and centralized finance.
  • Ability to lead through influence, build clear business cases, and write excellent documentation in English. This includes a strong working knowledge of EU crypto regulations (e.g., MiCA) to effectively partner with Risk, Legal, and Compliance teams.
  • Nice to haves:

About Notabene

Notabene is on a mission to make crypto a part of the everyday economy. Leading crypto organizations use our tools to reduce transaction risk and make crypto transfers safe. Working across three continents in eight countries, the Notabene team serves our fantastic community of 100+ customers, including financial institutions, fintechs, exchanges, and more. Our co-founders spearheaded foundational Self Sovereign Identity protocols and use-cases. This technology is key to the internals of our cutting edge tech stack.

We’re proud to have the support of leading investors, including Y Combinator, Jump Capital, Castle Island, Green Visor Capital, and more.

We’re at an exhilarating moment in our journey, as regulation technologies (reg-techs) are fast becoming recognized as a vital enabler of the crypto ecosystem. Notabene is growing fast—and we’re looking for people like you to help shape the future rails of the crypto industry!

The Impact You'll Have:

Every crypto transfer we touch moves between institutions that run their own systems, answer to different regulators, and have no reason to trust each other. The software in the middle has to be right every time. A message processed twice, a lost update, or a record shown to the wrong tenant is a compliance failure for our customers.

You’ll work on the core platform that carries this data between institutions around the world, written in Go.

As a Staff Engineer on the team you’ll build the hardest parts of it, contribute to its design, and help the engineers around you do their best work.

What You'll Do

  • Design and build core parts of our transaction platform.

  • Build for correctness under failure, with the isolation and auditability a regulated product needs.

  • Scale the platform as transaction volume and the number of institutions per node grow, keeping latency predictable and the database healthy.

  • Write design docs for what you build, and give sharp, useful reviews on other people’s designs and code.

  • Build with AI agents every day, and help improve the specs, context and review practices that make agent-written code safe to ship in a regulated product.

  • Work with product, compliance and customer-facing teams to turn regulatory and customer needs into working software.

  • Own what you ship in production, from tracing and alerts to incident follow-ups.

  • Mentor engineers on the team.

  • Work on an on call rotation

Must Haves

  • Systems design depth. You’ve designed and owned distributed systems where correctness matters more than features. You know asynchronous processing well and can reason about what happens when parts of it fail.

  • Strong Go, or deep production experience in another statically typed backend language (Java, Kotlin, Rust, C#) and the appetite to be shipping Go within your first weeks.

  • PostgreSQL in depth: schema design, query plans, locking and isolation levels, migrations on live systems, and multi-tenant data.

  • End-to-end ownership in the cloud. Working knowledge of AWS or GCP: IAM, networking, managed databases, queues and storage. You can read and change Terraform and debug production from traces and logs.

  • AI-native engineering. You use coding agents such as Claude Code or Cursor every day and can show how. You write the specs and context, break work down for them, and review their output as hard as a human pull request. You know where they fail.

  • Staff-level experience. A track record of delivering large, technically hard projects end to end and helping the engineers around you get better. Typically 8+ years building backend systems.

  • Clear, concise writing in a remote company that makes decisions in documents and async threads.

  • Security fundamentals for sensitive data: encryption in transit and at rest, key handling, minimising personal data, and least-privilege access.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Applied cryptography: encryption, signing and key management.

  • Decentralized identity: DIDs, verifiable credentials, DIDComm.

  • Regulated finance, payments or compliance: Travel Rule, AML, ISO 20022.

  • Building and running software under SOC 2 or ISO 27001 controls.

  • Crypto and blockchain knowledge: chains, addresses, assets, CAIP identifiers.

  • Node.js and TypeScript.

  • Queue and workflow systems, and modern observability tooling.

Benefits

  • Flexible Remote Work: Work from anywhere!

  • $1000 WFH Stipend: Use within your first year of employment.

  • MacBook Pro: Procured by you and your manager to find a model that meets your needs.

  • Unlimited PTO: We trust you to take as much holiday as you need.

  • Country-Specific Benefits: Statutory offerings and contributions, managed via our employer-of-record.

Apply Today!

If you strongly believe this role is for you, please apply. Notabene considers a broad array of candidates, including those without blockchain experience. Whether you’re returning to work after a gap in employment, or taking the next step in your career path, we will be glad to have you on our radar.
